Messages.Author: D.P. Hammersley
Messages.Body:
Could someone please clarify the fact that some of the Vampires from Dark
Sovereigns are subject to errata such as Donal and Contanza (both
Brujah) having sup. Presence not Dominate and also that Blythe (Tremere) has
only singular auspex. Could someone either officially confirm or deny these
points. Thanks.

Peter

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
CLA...@leeds.ac.uk (D.P. Hammersley) writes:



Donal and Contanza have superior Dominate and no Presence, as printed.
Blythe has normal (not superior) Auspex, and is mis-printed.

Official references:
-----
From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Re: TOM: DS: Swapping disciplines
Date: 6 Jan 1996 02:14:18 GMT
Message-ID: <4ckltq$3...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

L. Scott Johnson <sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu> wrote:
>Brujah - celerity, potence, and presence
> Constanza has superior celerity, potence, and dominate, but no presence
> Donal is the same way.
>Perhaps the 'Dominate' and the "Presence" keys are too close together
>on the Vampire keyboard? :-)

Heh. No, the designers of DS simply decided to step away from the
these-three-skills paradigm a little, and threw in a few vampires that
specialized in non-clan skills.

It's intentional, and would have crossed that threshhold if accidental.
-----
From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Blythe Candelaria
Date: 8 Dec 1995 05:30:43 GMT
Message-ID: <4a8ii3$d...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

Should have inferior, not superior, Auspex.
